overview.description: The Nuveen Dividend Growth Fund ETF (NUDG) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P 500 index. The fund is an actively managed equity ETF that focuses on large- and mid-cap companies with the potential for sustainable dividend growth. Holdings are selected based on company fundamentals within economic sectors of the market that have historically provided higher dividend yields. NUDG was launched on Jun 2, 2026 and is issued by Nuveen.

holdings.infoBox: NUDG is an equity ETF with a total of 43 individual holdings. The top holdings are Microsoft stock at 7.67%, Apple at 6.37%, Broadcom at 5.11%, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company at 4.47%, and Amphenol at 3.83%.
